speaker: abel_garnish
text: The K is where I left it. I have not grown it a number overnight. Do not ask me to be neat on a Thursday.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I was not going to ask you for a neatness, Abel. I was going to ask whether a yard that laughed yesterday is allowed to laugh again without a clerk. You, Will. I am still saying you. Be flattered. It costs me something.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear you. I am not flattered into a total. If you have a line that is better than mine, name it. I will not take a number in place of the name.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Naming is your trade. Laughing is mine. I can do mine without feeding yours. The groundlings paid for the laugh. They did not subscribe to your margin.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then laugh inside the pass we have, and leave the margin. I want the old Errors cues for two o'clock. I am in them. I am not in a siege across the water, whatever the Rose has pasted up.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The Rose has a Siege of London. That is a title on a bill. It is not a receipt, and it is not our afternoon. Nothing was bought.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not going to read their bill in the street. I have Egeon at two. A title is enough to envy, and not enough to cross for.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The songs stay. One stop in the owl, as it was. I am not teaching a new one because a morning feels bare. Sam copied what he copied. Nick is not fetched. His speech is not today's proof.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave Nick. I am not moving a third stop to make a Thursday look like work.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And leave the watchet rag out of it. John still has the mercer. I said so on Saturday. A gown is not my scene, and it has not become my scene by growing older.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The stable wall still has yesterday's speech, if anyone is collecting speeches. I am collecting entrances. Abel, the old book. Egeon, then the rest, and we stop.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The old book. No new side. The K stays a K. If I write a digit I will be lying about a count I have not made, and I do not lie in the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are understood. Courteous yesterday, plain today, and no figure. Walk Egeon. I would like to be wrong in the right part this afternoon, not in a column.
